evidence.title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory

summary: Researchers unveiled ReWorld, a new AI world model that can maintain and reason over extended temporal contexts, enabling more coherent long‑term planning and interaction. The system leverages a novel memory architecture to store and retrieve information across long horizons, pushing forward capabilities in simulation and decision‑making tasks.
title: ReWorld introduces an interactive world model with long‑horizon memory
